text:
## Training & Awareness  
**Mandatory Annual Training:**
- All staff: 1-hour complaint handling training
- Customer-facing staff: 2-hour practical scenarios + role play
- Management: Complaint governance and escalation
- Compliance: FCA rules and reporting requirements

raw_entities.name: Complaint Handling Policy
raw_entities.description: A policy governing complaint handling procedures across the bank, with mandatory training requirements for all staff levels and specific governance obligations for management and compliance functions.
context: Compliance: FCA rules and reporting requirements

raw_entities.name: Mandatory Annual Complaint Handling Training for All Staff
raw_entities.description: All staff members must complete a 1-hour complaint handling training annually as a mandatory requirement under the complaint handling policy.

raw_entities.name: Enhanced Complaint Handling Training for Customer-Facing Staff
raw_entities.description: Customer-facing staff must complete a 2-hour practical training program including scenarios and role-play exercises annually to ensure competency in complaint handling.
context: Customer-facing staff: 2-hour practical scenarios + role play

raw_entities.name: Management Complaint Governance and Escalation Training
raw_entities.description: Management staff must receive annual training on complaint governance structures and escalation procedures to ensure proper oversight and handling of complaints.

raw_entities.name: Compliance Staff Training on FCA Rules and Reporting Requirements
raw_entities.description: Compliance staff must receive annual training on FCA rules and reporting requirements to ensure the bank meets all regulatory obligations related to complaint handling and reporting.
context: Compliance: FCA rules and reporting requirements

raw_entities.name: All Staff
raw_entities.description: All bank staff members are required to complete mandatory annual complaint handling training to ensure consistent and compliant complaint management across the organization.

raw_entities.name: Customer-Facing Staff
raw_entities.description: Staff with direct customer interaction responsibilities must complete enhanced complaint handling training including practical scenarios and role-play to develop competency in managing customer complaints.
context: Customer-facing staff: 2-hour practical scenarios + role play

raw_entities.name: Management
raw_entities.description: Management is responsible for complaint governance and escalation procedures, requiring annual training to ensure proper oversight and handling of complaints within their areas of responsibility.

raw_entities.name: Compliance
raw_entities.description: The compliance function is responsible for ensuring adherence to FCA rules and managing complaint reporting requirements, requiring annual training on regulatory obligations.
context: Compliance: FCA rules and reporting requirements

raw_entities.name: Financial Conduct Authority Rules
raw_entities.description: FCA regulatory rules governing complaint handling and reporting requirements that the bank must comply with, forming the basis for the complaint handling policy and training obligations.
context: Compliance: FCA rules and reporting requirements
